curated.instructions: omr/instructions/9397-1-1.pdf, 9397-1-2.pdf, 9397-1-3.pdf (all three books build the logging truck; function pages: 9397-1-3.pdf pages 58-59)

functions.does: A Power Functions M motor in the chassis, switched on and reversed with the orange switch on the battery box, drives a gearbox with four driving rings; two blue-handled change-over levers, one on each side of the chassis behind the cab, choose which of the crane's four functions it works.
functions.source: book 1: gearbox sub-build steps 1-15 (pages 43-48) and steps 50-57; book 3: function pages 58-59 (each photo shows a lever's position and the battery box switch)
functions.note: levers: p217 3749 (handle, with catch p216 6641) and p221 3749 (handle, with catch p220 6641); battery box switch p1287 920; the motor is a control like a crank, and each function below names it with the lever setting it needs

functions.does: With one lever to one side, the motor lowers and raises the outrigger legs behind the cab, which stand the truck firm for craning.
functions.source: book 3: page 58 top (lever, switch, and the up-down arrow at the striped leg)
functions.note: inferred: the legs' parts weren't pinned down; the small linear actuator p463 is the likeliest drive. The lever direction (20 LDU) is a guess

functions.does: With the same lever the other way, the motor slews the crane round on its mast through a worm.
functions.source: book 3: page 58 bottom (the turning arrow round the crane's mast)
functions.note: the worm p534 drives a 24-tooth clutch gear (p551-p553) so the slewing slips at its ends; inferred: lever direction

functions.does: With the other lever to one side, the motor raises and lowers the crane's main boom by spinning the big linear actuator under it.
functions.source: book 3: page 59 top (the arrow lifting the boom)

functions.does: With the other lever the other way, the motor folds the crane's outer arm (the yellow jib) in and out with a second linear actuator.
functions.source: book 3: page 59 bottom (the arrow at the jib's tip)
functions.note: inferred: lever direction and the jib actuator's part

functions.does: The log grab at the jib tip opens and closes by hand, by turning a gear on top of it, and hangs free so it swings level.
functions.source: book 3: steps 140-152 (grab sub-build); inferred: the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: The front wheels steer from a knob on top of the cab (hand of god): its upright shaft turns a horizontal shaft through two knob gears, and a gear at its front end drives the steering rack.
functions.source: book 1: steering sub-build (steps 37-42); inferred: no arrow in the book

functions.does: Rolling the truck turns the engine: the two rear axles' differential drives a shaft forward to the crankshaft under the bonnet, so the four pistons go up and down.
functions.source: book 1: steps 1-24 (differential, long shaft, engine); inferred: no arrow in the book

functions.does: All six wheels roll; the front pair steer.

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
